additional_info.subject: ID0457907-DC/Si-D/DK-[RVP / T3 170004660] Missing Converters in DC1 CRM:03042000072
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0457907
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-DK SI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
RVP/T3170004660
Charger ID / Serial No.:
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Possible solution:
After following the error flag, we can see that converter 8 is missing in DC1. Please check the Fast Shutdown cable connected to the converter. Change the Fast Shutdown cable of converter 8 with the one beside it, just to confirm whether the problem is related to the shutdown cable. And when you are sure, replace them, I will send you the reference of the cable that is compatible with this charger.
-8EM5903-0AA04-6AA8 -WD47 40 kW Con Fast Shutd. cable 3-Pole Yellow High Flex DPA
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-
DK
SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Younes Baroudi
